policy.causal_rule: Ownership, product availability, derivative positioning, and repository test results do not by themselves prove XRP price causality. Keep source scope, cutoff, unit and uncertainty attached to every edge.

edges.claim: SBI Holdings says the acquisition completed Oct 1, 2026 and bitbank became wholly owned.
bitbank's official XRP market page documents XRP/JPY access and a May 2017 trading start. SBI ownership combines this existing venue with SBI's exchange group.
SBI/Visa reward card permits XRP as a selected crypto reward asset.
SBI VC Trade and Ripple announced RLUSD handling in Japan; this is a stablecoin product relationship, not proof of XRP demand.

Secondary dashboards report positive funding, high long-account ratios and long liquidations while price is down. This can indicate fragile long positioning but does not establish the next price direction.
Main no longer has the 30-minute cron schedule, but manual dispatch can still mutate simulated state/log and the nonzero position has null product identity. PR #1334 proposes a script-level guard.
Current artifact reports confidence 0.0 and provider failures; summary still narrates positive sentiment. No calibrated fixed-horizon forecast is issued.
Main's manual merge queue still has write permissions and merge commands; PR #1335 proposes a read-only replacement.

hypotheses.statement: SBI's full ownership of bitbank may strengthen Japanese XRP distribution and execution optionality because bitbank already offers XRP/JPY markets.
disconfirming_evidence: No post-acquisition XRP/JPY depth, volume, customer migration or net-flow change is measured; SBI said near-term consolidated earnings impact was expected to be limited.
tests_needed: Compare pre/post acquisition XRP/JPY spread, depth, turnover, active accounts, custody balances and net flows with broader Japan-market controls; check any exchange reporting changes.

hypotheses.statement: SBI is building multi-asset digital-asset distribution across XRP rewards and RLUSD handling rather than making an exclusive bet on XRP or stablecoins.
disconfirming_evidence: Product announcements do not show adoption, balance mix, route usage or whether activity is complementary versus substitutive.
tests_needed: Track issuer/asset balances, XRP reward conversion and redemption, SBI VC Trade volumes, RLUSD on/off-ramp volumes and route-level XRP bridge use.

hypotheses.statement: Falling XRP price with slightly rising aggregate open interest, positive funding and larger long liquidations may indicate fragile leveraged-long positioning and elevated squeeze/liquidation risk.
disconfirming_evidence: Funding is modest; the aggregate dashboard and Binance subset differ in cutoff and scope; account ratios are not notional exposure and OI can rise as hedges open.
tests_needed: Collect synchronized venue-level OI, funding interval, mark/index basis, liquidations, spot depth, volume and positioning with source timestamps; test out of sample against price-only and BTC-risk baselines.

hypotheses.statement: A descriptive news score with zero confidence and provider failures should remain NOT_ISSUED until a fixed-horizon target and calibrated out-of-sample model exist.
disconfirming_evidence: None for the fail-closed requirement; a separate calibrated model could later qualify after independent evaluation.
tests_needed: Keep provider-failure, malformed-input and stale-signal tests; separately build leakage-safe walk-forward evaluation and calibration before issuing a forecast.

notes: The acronym SBIC remains context-dependent; this snapshot adds verified SBI Group corporate and product relationships but does not resolve the original phrase's intended entity.
SBI's bitbank acquisition and XRP/JPY access are confirmed, but market impact remains unmeasured.
Derivatives observations are secondary and non-admitted; do not use them as forecast features until synchronized and independently corroborated.
Coinbase Q3 results are scheduled after US market close Oct 29; Circle Q3 results are scheduled Nov 4 at 08:00 ET. These are monitoring events, not directional signals.
Main's paper-trader cron schedule is already removed; manual dispatch remains unsafe until the position identity guard is approved and merged.
Main's merge queue remains mutation-capable; PR #1335 is draft/unmerged.
